notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Doppelganger is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Vesuvan Doppelganger do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by tapping it.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
